record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: For the quadratic complex Hénon map H2(x,y)=(y,x+y^2), can one describe the dynamics near the origin in C^2?

evidence.quote: Question 14. — Can we describe the dynamics of H2 near the origin in C2 ?

artifact.category_tag: Complex Hénon maps / local holomorphic dynamics
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a recent compilation of open problems on Hénon maps. A targeted web search did not turn up any subsequent paper providing a complete description of the local dynamics of the specific quadratic complex Hénon map H_2(x,y)=(y,x+y^2) near the origin, so the problem appears to remain open as of 2026.
